records.rationale: Reconstructing an order from greedy process traces teaches dependency reasoning and lexicographic choice;useful after standard topological ordering.
A useful advanced progression from a minimax recurrence to maintaining its result under point updates.
Offers distributed information aggregation and collision-free communication practice,but the multi-process protocol is specialized enrichment.
Connects interval containment to incremental connected components and efficient merging;strong practice after ordinary DSU and interval sorting.
Develops reconstruction from indirect range measurements and query economy;valuable advanced interactive enrichment.
Teaches separating all arrangements from connected arrangements and exploiting different dimension regimes.
An interesting graph-game exercise in exploiting structure and coordinating a team against one adversary.
Combines tree distance queries,bulk relocation and lazy per-location event accounting;useful advanced aggregation practice.
Teaches symmetry-invariant encoding and canonical representations;useful enrichment outside the core algorithm sequence.
Extends bottleneck-path and spanning-tree ideas to inverse graph construction with two coupled capacity systems.
Good practice in validating forced structure and building a directed spanning solution when forbidden edges are sparse.
A challenging communication/encoding puzzle illustrating adversarial online information;specialized enrichment rather than a standard prerequisite.
Offers advanced reachability-state compression with purchasable resources and interval coverage;best reserved for experienced students.
Combines multi-source distance modelling with a connectivity-preserving separator and minimax threshold reasoning.
